master_headline: MAN UTD TRANSFER NEWS: FULHAM DEFENDER CALVIN BASSEY IS IN TALKS OVER NEW CONTRACT AMID MAN UTD LINKS
ticker_text: SKY SPORTS: FULHAM OPEN TALKS WITH CALVIN BASSEY AMID MAN UTD INTEREST ✦ MARCO SILVA DETERMINED TO KEEP DEFENDER ✦

scenes.spoken_narration: Silva insists defender stays, while United press for his signature.
And — reports confirm Manchester United have tabled a thirty‑million pound offer for Calvin Bassey.

on_screen.headline: United table £30m offer for Calvin Bassey

scenes.spoken_narration: Now — United propose £30m fee plus add‑on clauses, yet Fulham demand longer contract.
Meanwhile — Silva urges board to seal extension before United finalise deal.
So — will United wait, or will Silva lock Bassey into Fulham?

on_screen.headline: Will United wait or Silva lock Bassey in?

scenes.spoken_narration: Either way — this is football in thirty seconds. Follow for daily transfer updates.
